token.title: 🔑 Tokeŋ GitHub
token.intro: GitHub ina jaaboo ɗaɓɓitanɗe 60 e waktu ñiiɓirde nde neldaani tokeŋ. Lekki forkeeji timmuki ina naamnoo hedde 32, ndeen e yillaare ɗiɗmere keerol ngol ina timma. Tokeŋ ina ɓeyda keerol ngol haa 5000 e waktu.
token.step1: Uddit Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, refti suɓo Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner (jom kuutorgal): konte maa. Expiration (gasgol): ñalawma kala, lekki ngii haajaaki hay huunde juutnde.
token.step4: Accu jamirooje fof hoto meemtu. Metaa mooftirɗe renndo haajaaki hay gooto e majje.
token.step5: Sos, refti natto keeñal {token}. GitHub ina hollira ɗum laawol gootol tan.
token.classic: Tokeŋ laaɗɗo kadi ina golla: sos gootel tawa hay keerol cuɓaaka. Keerol ɓolngol ina janngira keɓe renndo e njaawdi teeŋtinaandi.
token.stays: Ina heddoo e ndee wanngorde les coktirgal {key} ina yaha tan e {host}. Winndetaake abadaa e palal ñiiɓirde, ndeen jokkol ngol lollintaa ina roondii jiyannde nde wonaa ɓataake naatgol. Butoŋ les boowal ngal ina momta ɗum kadi e kaas.
token.persistHow: Waɗ tokeŋ oo e fiilde {env} sarworde jaggunde ngoo hello, sara {port}:
token.proxy: refti fuɗɗin ɗum e {make}. Ndeen ruuɓirgal ngal ina winnda taƴre nginx nde ɓeydata hoore {header} e proxy {path}, ndeen wanngorde ina noddoo iwdi mum, heɓataa tokeŋ abadaa. Ngal boowal ina majja, koɗɓe fof ina lollondira keewal gootal 5000 e waktu.
fork.refused404: Alaa diiɗe cabbi: {message}. 404 ɗoo ko cabbal ngal woodaani walla laawol ngol proxy sarworde roondaani; laylaytol forkeeji dow ɗoo timmii no feewi fof.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub dañaani ɗaɓɓitanɗe e oo waktu, ndeen diiɗe cabbi mbaawaani natteede. Laylaytol forkeeji dow ɗoo timmii. Ɓeydu tokeŋ e alluwal cuɓol, walla ñif diiɗe cabbi e alluwal mbaadi ngam huutoraade keewal ngal e laylaytol tan.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub jaabii {status} e asli komiteeji, ndeen diiɗe cabbi mbaawaani natteede. Laylaytol forkeeji dow ɗoo timmii.
